contract.target: m_t = sum_i w_i E[Y_i|F_{i-1}] / sum_i w_i
contract.envelope: D_max(m)=max prod_i(1-(1-exp(-lambda w_i))*mu_i) subject to 0<=mu_i<=1 and sum_i w_i mu_i=Wm

implementation.method: Exact breakpoint/water-filling KKT solver. Precompute intervals in c where mu_i=clip(1/a_i-c/w_i,0,1). On an interval S(c)=C-Kc and log D_max(c)=B+K log c, so each envelope query is a segment lookup plus closed-form evaluation.
implementation.endpoint_inversion: monotone bisection over m using a fixed lambda mixture

two_coordinate_direct_scalar_optimizatio.interpretation: Largest discrepancies occurred near active bounds and are compatible with bounded scalar optimizer tolerance; no counterexample to the KKT solution was found.

small_multivariate_slsqp.interpretation: Nonconverged SLSQP runs are not counted as validation successes or contradictions.

endpoint_monotonicity_and_conservative_d.scope: Deliberately heterogeneous synthetic predictable weights and low fractional mismatch scores; these are not production width estimates.

runtime_interpretation: After breakpoint precomputation, exact endpoint cost is nearly flat through n=5000 in this Python microbenchmark. Rebuilding the five breakpoint tables dominates at large n; the prototype is not yet incremental, so a streaming deployment should not rebuild from scratch at every observation.
measurement_validity: The exact endpoint is for the time-varying predictable-weight average conditional mean; it is not automatically a fixed population request-mismatch rate.
Realized process size that can react to the current outcome is not a valid weight under this contract.
Endpoint narrowing versus the conservative prototype is mathematical/synthetic evidence only, not a production calibration result.
Successful numerical checks support implementation correctness but do not replace the supermartingale proof already recorded in the predecessor checkpoint.
next_actions: Add an incremental or batched breakpoint-table update path so streaming monitoring does not pay O(n log n) rebuild cost every observation.
Formalize prospective equal-size exposure blocks under adaptive process termination and state exactly which observed-block or counterfactual exposure estimand is controlled.
Compare this exact envelope with public importance-weighted/time-uniform methods under the same predictable-weight estimand rather than generic interval width.
